title: Repeat Extension Pricing Schedule for the Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
Extensions on a Builder Extended Rate Lock that has already been extended or relocked are priced with a step-up on every increment after the first increment of the extension.

**Schedule.** A lock has been relocked when its ledger carries a relock fee charge. On a lock that has been relocked, the step-up multiplier is one plus the number of relock fee charges on the lock ledger plus 0.5 for each increment written before this extension; on a lock that has not been relocked but carried increments written before this extension, it is one plus 0.5 for each increment written before this extension; on any other lock it is one. Each increment after the first increment priced is charged at the per-increment extension fee times the step-up multiplier.

The increments written before this extension are the extensions used on the lock record less the increments the extension being priced adds.

## Method by lock history

| Lock history on the ledger and lock record | Each increment after the first priced is charged at |
|---|---|
| one or more relock fee charges on the ledger | the per-increment fee times one, plus the number of relock fee charges, plus 0.5 for each earlier increment |
| no relock fee charge, one or more earlier increments | the per-increment fee times one plus 0.5 for each earlier increment |
| no relock fee charge, no earlier increment | the per-increment fee |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs, per-increment fee USD 400.00, two increments priced)

| Relock fee charges | Earlier increments | Multiplier | Second increment charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 1 | 400.00 |
| 0 | 1 | 1.5 | 600.00 |
| 0 | 2 | 2 | 800.00 |
| 1 | 0 | 2 | 800.00 |
| 1 | 1 | 2.5 | 1000.00 |

The first increment priced is not multiplied.
